scope: Mocked Gnosis indexer failure paths only; no RPC provider or database access
checks: A failed latest-block RPC lookup returns only the exception class and does not expose the synthetic credential-bearing URL
A failed block range persists a safe exception-class summary and returns a safe scheduler error while preserving rollback and last-checkpoint behavior
An outbox failure remains typed but uses a fixed summary in both durable status and the propagated exception
Failure-status persistence logging records only the secondary exception class

focused_tests.python_mode: python -s to exclude a broken user-site pytest plugin entrypoint

limitations: No RPC provider, ClickHouse service, candidate database, or legacy database was contacted
Safe summaries intentionally omit provider response details; operators receive the error class and failed block-range context
This does not implement legacy receipt backfill, removed-log rollback, deep-reorg reconciliation, or live provider acceptance
